SELECT examWrongQuestionBook.* , examStudent.real_name AS realName , examCourse.course_name AS courseName , examQuestion.question_title AS questionTitle , examQuestion.question_type AS questionType , examQuestionPracticeRecord.student_answer AS lastWrongAnswer , examQuestionPracticeRecord.id AS id2 FROM exam_wrong_question_book examWrongQuestionBook LEFT JOIN exam_student examStudent ON examWrongQuestionBook.student_id = examStudent.id LEFT JOIN exam_course examCourse ON examWrongQuestionBook.course_id = examCourse.id LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examWrongQuestionBook.question_id = examQuestion.id LEFT JOIN exam_question_practice_record examQuestionPracticeRecord ON examWrongQuestionBook.last_practice_record_id = examQuestionPracticeRecord.id
ORDER BY examWrongQuestionBook.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exam_wrong_question_book examWrongQuestionBook LEFT JOIN exam_student examStudent ON examWrongQuestionBook.student_id = examStudent.id LEFT JOIN exam_course examCourse ON examWrongQuestionBook.course_id = examCourse.id LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examWrongQuestionBook.question_id = examQuestion.id LEFT JOIN exam_question_practice_record examQuestionPracticeRecord ON examWrongQuestionBook.last_practice_record_id = examQuestionPracticeRecord.id

SELECT examWrongQuestionBook.* , examStudent.real_name AS realName , examCourse.course_name AS courseName , examQuestion.question_title AS questionTitle , examQuestion.question_type AS questionType , examQuestionPracticeRecord.student_answer AS lastWrongAnswer , examQuestionPracticeRecord.id AS id2 FROM exam_wrong_question_book examWrongQuestionBook LEFT JOIN exam_student examStudent ON examWrongQuestionBook.student_id = examStudent.id LEFT JOIN exam_course examCourse ON examWrongQuestionBook.course_id = examCourse.id LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examWrongQuestionBook.question_id = examQuestion.id LEFT JOIN exam_question_practice_record examQuestionPracticeRecord ON examWrongQuestionBook.last_practice_record_id = examQuestionPracticeRecord.id
ORDER BY examWrongQuestionBook.create_time DESC

SELECT examWrongQuestionBook.* , examStudent.real_name AS realName , examCourse.course_name AS courseName , examQuestion.question_title AS questionTitle , examQuestion.question_type AS questionType , examQuestionPracticeRecord.student_answer AS lastWrongAnswer , examQuestionPracticeRecord.id AS id2 FROM exam_wrong_question_book examWrongQuestionBook LEFT JOIN exam_student examStudent ON examWrongQuestionBook.student_id = examStudent.id LEFT JOIN exam_course examCourse ON examWrongQuestionBook.course_id = examCourse.id LEFT JOIN exam_question examQuestion ON examWrongQuestionBook.question_id = examQuestion.id LEFT JOIN exam_question_practice_record examQuestionPracticeRecord ON examWrongQuestionBook.last_practice_record_id = examQuestionPracticeRecord.id WHERE examWrongQuestionBook.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exam_wrong_question_book WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 1

SELECT w.course_id AS courseId, IFNULL(MAX(c.course_name), '未分类') AS courseName, COUNT(1) AS wrongCount FROM exam_wrong_question_book w LEFT JOIN exam_course c ON w.course_id = c.id WHERE w.student_id = #{studentId} AND w.status = 1 GROUP BY w.course_id ORDER BY wrongCount DESC

SELECT IFNULL(q.question_type, 0) AS questionType, COUNT(1) AS wrongCount FROM exam_wrong_question_book w LEFT JOIN exam_question q ON w.question_id = q.id WHERE w.student_id = #{studentId} AND w.status = 1 GROUP BY IFNULL(q.question_type, 0)
